title: Florida House, District 85
what_it_does: Represents District 85 (Parts of Martin, St. Lucie) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings. Positions have not been researched yet.

candidates.name: Anthony Bonna
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Owner of Good Help Group (marketing firm); Port St. Lucie City Council member; former St. Lucie County commissioner
candidates.background: Anthony Bonna grew up on the Treasure Coast, earned a finance degree from Georgetown University and has owned Good Help Group, a marketing and communications company, since 2011. Gov. Rick Scott appointed him to the St. Lucie County Commission in 2018, and he was elected to the Port St. Lucie City Council in 2021 and re-elected in 2022. He is an Eagle Scout, a Rotarian and a father of three.

candidates.name: Wayne Richter
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.occupation: Attorney (solo practice in Palm City and West Palm Beach); past president of the Martin County Bar Association
candidates.background: Wayne Richter is a solo-practice attorney with offices in Palm City and West Palm Beach who has lived on the Treasure Coast since 2004. He earned a political science degree from Florida Southern College and a law degree from South Texas College of Law, is past president of the Martin County Bar Association and vice president of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers. He lives in Palm City with his wife and three children.

candidates.name: Amr Metwally
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Amr Metwally is a software engineer and business owner who lists MetWeb, MGTOW.TV and a restaurant among his businesses. He is running under the MGTOW Party label and has also filed as a federal candidate. His platform page mixes state and federal proposals.

candidates.name: Hunter Stone
candidates.occupation: Write-in candidate: the name is not printed on the ballot; voters must write it on the blank line
candidates.background: Hunter Stone Crompton is a write-in candidate whose site says he was diagnosed with autism at age 2, has worked for a supervisor of elections office and as a congressional intern, and believes in civil service. His name is not printed on the ballot.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

guns.summary: Crompton's campaign site says he would defend First and Second Amendment rights, describing the Constitution as a living document rather than just a piece of paper. He does not propose specific changes to Florida's gun laws.

sources.title: Hunter Stone Crompton - Write Him In For The Win, District 85 State Representative

environment.summary: Crompton calls for reviving New Deal-style programs at the state and federal level, including a Civilian Conservation Corps for environmental preservation and jobs in land conservation and restoration.

sources.title: Hunter Stone Crompton - Write Him In For The Win, District 85 State Representative

other_issues.title: Jobs and surveillance
other_issues.summary: He proposes reviving Civilian Conservation Corps and WPA-style public jobs programs, says no one should go hungry or without shelter, supports officers who serve the Constitution and opposes expanding camera surveillance.

sources.title: Hunter Stone Crompton - Write Him In For The Win - campaign site

other_issues.title: Surveillance and civil liberties
other_issues.summary: Crompton says he would work to end what he calls surveillance overreach that expanded after 9/11, and argues local money should go to basic infrastructure such as street lights rather than to installing surveillance equipment.

sources.title: Hunter Stone Crompton - Write Him In For The Win, District 85 State Representative

other_issues.title: Public jobs programs
other_issues.summary: Crompton proposes reviving Works Progress Administration-style programs to create public employment, and says politics should be the people's business rather than a business venture.

sources.title: Hunter Stone Crompton - Write Him In For The Win, District 85 State Representative
